metadata.purpose: Maintain legal, operational, and canonical compliance for TriadicFrameworks LLC.

compliance_items.title: Michigan Annual Statement Filing
compliance_items.description: Annual filing with Michigan LARA to maintain good standing.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Verify registered agent and office; confirm no structural changes.

compliance_items.title: Registered Agent Review
compliance_items.description: Confirm ZenBusiness Inc. remains active and correct.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Update LARA filing if agent changes.

compliance_items.title: EIN & IRS Record Check
compliance_items.description: Verify EIN status and responsible party information.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Ensure EIN matches LLC data; update IRS if address or ownership changes.

compliance_items.title: Operating Agreement Review
compliance_items.description: Review governance document for accuracy and canon alignment.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Ensure IP ownership clauses reflect canon and module lineage.

compliance_items.title: Tax Classification Review
compliance_items.description: Evaluate whether to remain a disregarded entity or elect S-Corp.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Consider payroll tax optimization if hiring or revenue increases.

compliance_items.title: Intellectual Property Review
compliance_items.description: Review trademarks, copyrights, and domain assets.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Include canon modules, metadata schemas, RTT equations, and branding.

compliance_items.title: Q1 Financial Review
compliance_items.agent_notes: Ensure clean separation of personal and business finances.

compliance_items.title: Q2 Financial Review
compliance_items.agent_notes: Track module development costs for potential R&D credits.

compliance_items.title: Q3 Financial Review
compliance_items.agent_notes: Ensure compliance with fiscal year cycle starting July 1.

compliance_items.title: Q4 Financial Review
compliance_items.agent_notes: Prepare for tax season and annual filings.

compliance_items.title: DBA Renewal — Nawder Loswin
compliance_items.agent_notes: Wayne County; filed through ZenBusiness PBC.

compliance_items.title: Payroll Compliance Setup
compliance_items.description: Triggered when hiring employees or contractors.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Register for Michigan UIA and Treasury withholding; federal forms 941, 940, W-2, W-3.

compliance_items.title: IRS Entity Election Review
compliance_items.description: Evaluate need for S-Corp or C-Corp election.
compliance_items.agent_notes: Use Form 2553 or Form 8832 if electing.
